en.headline: Housing Authority to raise carpark fees from January 2027
en.dek: Monthly rates for private cars will rise by HK$130 to HK$150, with hourly charges up by HK$1, as the authority aligns with market levels and expands EV charging sharing.
body: The Hong Kong Housing Authority said its Commercial Buildings Sub-committee had approved modest increases in carpark fees under its management, effective from 1 January 2027.

According to the authority, open parking spaces for private cars will cost between HK$1,840 and HK$2,880 a month after a HK$130 rise, while covered spaces will range from HK$2,210 to HK$3,460 after a HK$150 increase. Light goods vehicles, motorcycles and larger vehicles will see rises of between HK$50 and HK$200 depending on type and whether the space is covered or open.
Hourly rates for private cars, light goods vehicles and motorcycles will rise by HK$1 across all districts. Day parking for private cars will increase by HK$10 and 24-hour parking by HK$15.

A spokesman said a market study showed that comparable carpark fees had generally risen since the last review. The adjustment aims to bring charges closer to prevailing market levels while maintaining the authority’s financial stability.

Separately, the authority will introduce dedicated charging-sharing zones for monthly tenants at 27 pilot carparks from 1 January, allowing users to share chargers. Operators will set the charging fees with prior approval from the authority. Charging fees at other carparks will remain unchanged.

zh.headline: 房委會明年一月起上調停車場收費
zh.dek: 私家車月租加130至150元，時租加1元，以貼近市場水平，並擴展電動車充電共享區。
body: 房屋委員會表示，轄下商業樓宇小組委員會已通過輕微上調停車場收費，由2027年1月1日起生效。
房委會指，私家車露天泊位月租將加130元，介乎1840至2880元；有蓋泊位加150元，介乎2210至3460元。輕型貨車、電單車及大型車輚的月租加幅視車種及泊位類型而定，介乎50至200元。
所有地區的私家車、輕型貨車及電單車時租收費將上調1元。私家車「日泊」加10元，「24小時泊」加15元。
發言人表示，市場研究顯示自上次檢討以來，同類停車場月租普遍上升。調整旨在使收費更貼近市場水平，並維持房委會財政穩健。
另外，房委會將於2027年1月1日起，在27個先導計劃停車場為月租使用者設立專用「充電共享區」，讓有需要的使用者共用充電器。充電費用由營運商參考市場水平釐定，並須事先取得批准。其他停車場的時租充電收費維持不變。
